examples.text: ñattidutiyena kammena kuṭivatthuṃ na desāpetvā, āyāmato vā vitthārato vā antamaso kes'aggamattam'pi atikkāmetvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge payoge dukkaṭaṃ.
aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā'ti ṭhapetvā heṭṭhimaṃ aṭaniṃ, taṃ atikkāmetvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ, paṭilābhena chinditvā pācittiyaṃ desetabbaṃ.
vicintayitvā dhamm'atthaṃ, saccaṃ addasa passayaṃ, sacce ṭhatvā pamocesiṃ, ñātīnaṃ taṃ atikkhayaṃ.

2094.meaning1: too soon; too quickly; within a short time

examples.text: sant'ānanda, devatā ākāse pathavīsaññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti, vivaṭṭanti, atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatī'ti.
acaritvā brahmacariyaṃ, aladdhā yobbane dhanaṃ, senti cāpa-atikhīṇā'va, purāṇāni anutthunaṃ.
tathā hi pana, bhante, bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ atikhuddakaṃ nisīdanaṃ anuññātan'ti.

2098.meaning1: overcoming; surmounting; crossing; going past; going beyond

examples.text: pañca chinde pañca jahe, pañca c'uttari bhāvaye, pañca saṅga-atigo bhikkhu, oghatiṇṇo'ti vuccati.
sīmā-atigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi, ñatvā va disvā va samuggahītaṃ, na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tass'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītan'ti.
